hypothesis.statement: Official cache cleanup and stateless Docker pruning may recover installation space without disrupting active containers, volumes, Voicebox or character artifacts.
hypothesis.action: Prune Docker build cache and unused images, then run official pip, Homebrew, pnpm, uv and CocoaPods cache cleanup commands; compare protected workload identities before and after.
hypothesis.expectedResult: Recover meaningful host space while preserving every active and stateful workload, then reassess rather than guessing that 80 GiB was reached.

removedMaterial: Docker images unused by running containers
recovery: Removed material is not in Trash; it is recoverable only by pulling, rebuilding or redownloading.
qualityBoundary: Disk cleanup does not improve the character and does not prove Unreal/MetaHuman readiness.
decision: Do not delete Xcode simulator/device data, Android SDK/NDK, Google/Raspberry Pi caches or the entire Gradle cache without a more specific user decision.
